subject: POC wrap-up: LumenHealth pilot metrics & request for short reference
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Ana Soto <ana.soto@lumenhealth.com>, James Reynolds <j.reynolds@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC wrap-up: LumenHealth pilot metrics & request for short reference

Hi Ana / James —

Thanks again for running the three-week pilot with Redwood. We hit the goals we set together and I wanted to share a concise recap plus a small ask: would your team be open to a 15–20 minute reference call and a one-line quote we can use in a short case snippet?

Quick highlights from the pilot (attached PDF with raw logs):
- Average inference latency (p95): 78ms (target: <=120ms)
- Cost per 1k tokens (net, after autoscaling): $0.27 (projected 35% savings vs current infra)
- Throughput: sustained 22 rps during peak synthetic load (70 concurrent users)
- Accuracy proxy (intent-match F1 on eval set): 0.91
- Time to integrate (end-to-end): 4 days from onboarding to first successful end-to-end test

Attachments: pilot_results_lumenhealth.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB) — includes dashboards, latency histograms, and sample prompts. Also attaching a one-pager if helpful: redwood_onepager_pilot.docx.

Ask: If you’re comfortable, can we schedule a 15–20 minute reference call next week? We’d aim to cover the business outcomes you saw and get a 1–2 sentence quote about impact to include in a short write-up. Suggested times: Tue 6/15 10:00–11:30 PT or Wed 6/16 14:00–16:00 PT. If neither works, send a couple windows that do.

Also: if there are any follow-ups you want on the data (more granular cost breakdown, model variant logs), Rafael and Marissa are cc’d and can surface those quickly.

Thanks again — excited about the progress and potential next steps.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

--
Attachment: pilot_results_lumenhealth.pdf
--
Attachment: redwood_onepager_pilot.docx

From: Ana Soto <ana.soto@lumenhealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: James Reynolds <j.reynolds@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC wrap-up: LumenHealth pilot metrics & request for short reference

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the clear recap and for the detailed attachments. The metrics line up with what our product team observed in the dashboard — latency was consistently better than our internal baseline and the cost projection looks right (we ran a budget sanity check).

We’re happy to help. A couple small notes before we appear on a call:
- Can you include a 1-slide summary of business impact (ops saved, estimated monthly savings) ahead of the call? James prefers a one-slide brief.
- For the quote, we’ll need an internal approvals check; if you can send a 1–2 sentence suggested quote, that speeds sign-off.

We can do Tue 6/15 at 10:30 PT for a quick 20-minute sync — that works for James and me.

Regards,
Ana Soto
Director of AI Integrations, LumenHealth
ana.soto@lumenhealth.com
